nom: Peter Thomas Roth Pumpkin Enzyme Mask Enzymatic Dermal Resurfacer

avis.texte: Been using this stuff for years and its a must have in my skincare lineup. I love the formula and the pumpkin smell. You definitely need to train your skin to get used to it so start off once a week and work your way up. You don't have to use this everyday. When you need a reset this product is amazing.

Why isn't there more buzz around this product? It's phenomenal! I love that you see results after 1 use. The multi-exfoliation formula is fantastic and it smells amazing. Try it on your hands, elbows, knees......any place that needs targeted exfoliation. It's my holy grail mask for exfoliation and when I feel my skin needs a reboot.
Bought this in an autumn mood. Exfoliates. Smells amazing. Rinses clean. It's my weekend treat to myself.

I have repurchased this at least 4 times now: there's nothing else like it. Physical and chemical exfoliation-I desperately need both because I get clogged pores and flakes that a chemical formula just can't help. If you have sensitive skin, this might not be a good option-but if you reallllllly need a scrub-this is the one .

I enjoyed this and liked how my skin looked when using it. This is one I'm wanting to rebuy even though it costs more than some. It was not harsh or irritating but I don't have sensitive skin. I'm very sensitive to smells and it didn't bother me. If you're on the fence and need exfoliation give it a try.
Easy to apply feels great and my skin feels feels good.The next day
I loved this mask because not only it smells good, it has a live ingredient in it. It tingles, and you feel so cleaned and with a glow after the final facial steps.

I have a tendency to have skin that cant decide from week to week if its going to be oily or dry. I love doing face masks but was in the mood for something with a little more oomph that could also help clear up my skin. Let me start by saying this mask smells like you could eat it. I used a silicone applicator brush to initially put it on and it felt like a cool layer of ice on my face. You have to rub it in for about a minute and then you leave it on only for a short time. Now, I have sensitive skin so was worried initially but if I aim for about 5 minutes with it on it gives a nice tingle but when washed off makes my face feel super soft and fresh and clean. I only use this about once a week, but it definitely does the trick. I would definitely recommend!!

One of my FAVORITE skincare products of all times. Makes my skin so so smooth and fights acne and texture. BUT it is pretty irritating and it may take time to get used to the burn. Its a good types of tingly burn for me and still a 10/10 cause its THAT good!
Love this product. It makes my skin look amazing each time I use it. I highly recommend

avis.titre: Only The Best Products For My Skin
avis.texte: This is a must have in everyone's skincare regimen I trust all Peter Thomas Roth products , they always deliver! Trust me, use the best & enjoy having lovely skin!

Still a staple product for me. I starting buying it when my daughter was a baby and she's graduating from college next month! It's still effective but a little less than before; noticed it's gotten more watery and less gritty than it used to be.
I've used this for about a year. The results are well worth the cost of the product. it leaves my skin feeling great and dinshes wrinkles

This is one of my favorite masks, my skin looks and feels great after using it. You can usually buy a kit that lets you same the didfernt PTR masks if you want to spend a little less money to try it before you purchase a full sized product.
immediately saw it did in fact exfoliate way better than anything ive used. leaving the skin soft.
A simple at home regiment that smells good and has multi benefits for your skin. Exfoliates/polishes and leave skin feeling baby smooth. Pumpkin is a positive!
I have repurchased this mask 3 times. That's how good it is. If you like a good exfoliation, get this mask.
This is the real deal… this isn't for everybody, but this is some good stuff! Don't use this every day! This is a once in a while mask! But it leaves your skin radiant!

I was looking for a more affordable AHA mask after going through thr drunk elephant sukari baby facial. I've tried others that didn't give me the same results until this one. It does tingle and I wouldnt recommend for super sensitive skin. I use this about 2x a week and its improved my hyperpigmentation and overall skin texture

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: The product goes on easy and is not heavy and doesn't pull your skin tight. It makes your skin feel great after the first use.
A perfect mask that does not burn but does the job. The skin feels so Soft. Highly recommend.

The smell is incredible! I do find the grit of the exfoliation to be too rough for my skin, so can only use once in a blue moon. Skin feels amazing after each use though. Soft, clean no residue and refreshed!

avis.titre: This exfoliator leaves skin looking bright, noticeably!
avis.texte: This enzyme mask works well in leaving your skin texture smoother and brighter. As far as I can tell, results show immediately. I love the smell, too! I will say, you have to read and follow directions because it is a very strong exfoliant.
I love this product leave my skin feeling amazing. Exfoliates very well. Smells great. I hope this isnt seasonal i really want to keep using this in my skin routine

I previously used this pumpkin mask on a regular basis and my skin was clear and smooth! I stopped using it for six months and noticed my face to revert to looking dark and feeling dry. I recently resumed using the mask for one week and my daughter and others have been asking, "what is on your face?" because it is bright, glowing and looks moisturized. the results are noticeable. I will not sway to another product or stop using Peter Thomas Roth Pumpkin Enzyme Mask that also smells delicious!

avis.titre: I really like it but sensitive skin - beware!
avis.texte: I'm not unfamiliar with acid peels and I'd been using one from the Ordinary. I decided to try this one because it had great reviews and seemed more robust. The good part - For me, the mask smells divine so I really enjoyed using it. The fine grit of the exfoliant made my skin feel polished and I noticed a visible improvement in my skin texture and acne in one use. The bad part - because I'm familiar with the Ordinary I thought surely I could use this mask twice a week! That was wrong, and I managed to mildly burn my skin in about two minutes. I'm going to keep it and use it sparingly because the results were too good for me to walk away from, but if you have sensitive skin this may not be for you, or may need to be used just once per week or every other week.

Reading other reviews I realize I could just be extremely sensitive to this mask but man does it burn! I had to sit in front of a fan on blast and even then it was tough to sit through 5 min haha. My skin LOVED it though, so it must do something good. Beauty is pain my mama always said!

I love this product so much. It smells good, but it also helped my acne sooo much. It burns a little, not sure if it's because I have sensitive skin but my acne scars have disappeared and my rough bumpy comedones/texture are gone. My face is so smooth and clear. I've used so many products and nothing ever worked.

I tried PTR for the first time. I was a bit scared because even though my face is not overly sensitive, it is very acne prone and that alone makes it feel pretty delicate. I started off using this mask twice a week and although it does feel like a slightly burning sensation, it's not bad. Just the right amount that someone with sensitive skin would feel. My face looks a bit red after removal, but quickly fades away to a clean and shimmering face. My acne got a bit more intense after the first few uses, but according to my dermatologist, this is normal when trying out a product that I've never used before. Now I use this mask about 3-4 times per week and the acne has incredibly reduced, my pores feel a bit tighter and my face feels clearer.

I had a pretty bad reaction to this. I do have sensitive skin so it's hard to find masks that don't irritate my face. I left it on for 3 minutes, it did not burn. However, my skin reacted after I applied my normal, every day moisturizer.

I got a sample of this product and was so amazed at how it worked. I couldn't stop thinking about how great it worked and I finally made the splurge to buy this. It is so amazing. I put it on and scrub it feels so good. When I am rinsing it off I can see black beads and whiteheads coming off with it. My skin is instantly glowing, soft, smooth. It looks like I have a filter on. This is the best face mask I have ever used and I have used many. I use AHA/BHA regularly and retinol but nothing works as well as this mask to really exfoliate.

Originally, I got a sample size and fell in love so I went back and bought the full size. I love the way it makes my skin feel and look. Glowing and exfoliated. It has a nice tingling/mild burning sensation that I like too. It wakes me up and makes me feel like its working

I bought this for my chin area. My pores there were constantly getting clogged since Covid and wearing masks. Additionally the smooth skin was rough and prone to acne all of a sudden. I am well past my teenage years. I tried this mask as I know pumpkin is great for the skin and my chin now looks like it used to before Covid. It is a miracle! It also smells great!

I loved this. I have slightly sensitive combination skin, it felt tingly after a minute, then after 4 it started to lightly burn so I washed in cool water and applied a serum, my skin looks bright and clean, no redness after. The smell is wonderful, it's like dipping your face in a pumpkin pie.

I really loved the smell and was excited to use it. I put it on and it started to tingle immediately it then began to burn ):. Not sure if that's normal or if it's my skin? Lol it's worked great it seems but def felt like i rubbed chile on my skin.

avis.titre: By lengths and bounds the best facial product on the market!
avis.texte: I use this product about twice a week. I love the tingly sensation and the glorious smell. It's not artificial fragrance it's the natural pumpkin extract. I've gone through about 5 of these!

avis.titre: This is better than a facial
avis.texte: Every time I use this people tell me my skin looks amazing and ask me what I'm doing

I have combination skin but am more on the oily side and this mask is amazing . I haven't used it in years , but after finally repurchasing it I have noticed the different in my skin already . My face is super bright , clear, and glowy. All the small pimples that were visible are now gone . 10/10 it's worth your money

Really masks my skin so soft and supple the following AM. I suggest easing into a routine with this product if you're a first time user. Like x1-2 week for only 3-4 minutes and build up from there as directions suggest. Don't forget sunscreen the following morning!

I absolutely love this mask,you definitely notice a difference after using it! My skin looks brighter, more evenly toned and glowy! I leave it on for 10 minutes and my skin is just fine! Just got a new tub yesterday and the vitamin-c brightening cream with it!! Love them both!!!

This is the first "resurfacing" mask my fair, sensitive, often-reactive and red, combo dry skin has been able to tolerate. I can even leave it on for the full 7 minutes. I love the pumpkin aroma too. I purchased the 5pc PTR Mask Try-It Kit (only $19) and I'm so glad I did! So far I've bought the full-size pumpkin and cucumber masks. PTR's Water Drench Cloud Cream Moisturizer and Eye Gel are also HGs - I use them daily. They're magical! PTR understands my skin like no other brand.

avis.auteur: dry skin, no allergies to any ingred
avis.texte: i got this in the tiny trial set thing and my LORD this burned so bad on my face i had to immediately take it off. my eyes have become more sensitive (as i wear contacts more) and i do use other BHA's & AHA's in my routine, but i didn't use any sensitizing ingredients before i put this on and jeez louise OW! if your skin can take it, i'm sure it does a wonderful job, but it is heavily fragranced and burns!

So the key is with this for us girls with sensitive skin only leave this on for 2 min and wet your skin first. Start with only 2 min then build up to 5 introduce your skin slowly to this product. It has removed dead skin cells and polished my dull skin, moisturizer and serums soak in to my skin now instead of just sitting on top. My foundation looks so much better also. My skin was only red for about 10 min then it went away.

This is the only mask I have ever used that I can honestly say I notice a visible difference after washing it off. My skin looks so bright and healthy. I should note it stingles (somewhere between stings and tingles), a lot, in the first few minutes, but it's nothing I can't handle and the results are worth the 1-2 minutes of slight discomfort. Oh and it smells like Pumpkin Pie! The only think I have found that comes close to this is the Freeman, ACV clay mask. If your on a budget, but the results aren't as noticeable.
Yes Absolutely love it smells great your face is super clean so far of the stuff I found

avis.titre: Love this mask! Smells great, feels wonderful!
avis.texte: Wonderful product! Smells good enough to eat, but don't! Feels sooo good!
I use this about once a week to help my skin look smoother. I will use it Friday night before going out for smoother foundation application. Be careful because it does burn at first.

avis.titre: grainy and hard to take off
avis.texte: The benefit of a good enzyme mask for me is getting that baby fresh skin without the scratching and potential damage that happens with physical exfoliation. unfortunately this misses the mark for me it is grainy and scratchy and nearly impossible to remove without pain. it smells great I just wish the texture was better.

I am obsessed with this product. It's expensive but not nearly as expensive as a chemical peel would be—plus it lasts forever. If you're trying to save money by getting one of the mini containers that comes with the variety pack, I'd say spend the extra dollars for this guy and bump the others. Trust me you'll go through this one first and the other masks will end up collecting dust because the results with this product are undeniable even after one use; but continued use is off the charts impressive. I wash my face with a cleansing brush and tone with witch hazel before applying this, just to make sure my skin is super clean—then I follow up with a serum and moisturize as usual. Your skin is going to be open to receive your best products after using this so if there's a special serum or moisturizer you keep for special occasions, break it out after this. Do not use this product on sensitive or irritated skin ya'll—you will absolutely regret it immediately. This product is strong and it burns even on regular skin so try not to get addicted to the results and use this more than twice a week or you will burn your face off hunny.
Smells amazing and makes my skin feel nice and look brighter.
I could only keep this on my face for like a minute. It burned so bad!

I had some dry patches on my nose, was going to go to the dermatologist to have them burned off. My skin is fair, I am 59 years old and usually have little bumps and scaly things burned off each year by the dermatologist. I used this amazing mask and the scaly things on my nose disappeared! and my skin felt softer afterward as well.

This stuff smells amazing and makes my skill feel so smooth and tightened after every use. I initially bought it with the PTR mask sample pack and have used it faster than the other 3 in the pack… because it is the BEST! Now getting the full size! I use 2 times a week.

has the most beautiful sweet pumpkin pie smell. makes me feel so happy using it cus it reminds me of thanksgiving. i tried the ordinary peel and it wasn't giving for me, so i tried this. slightly drying but that's not surprising. try it!!
THIS PRODUCT LEFT ME WITH A RASH ON MY LEFT CHEEK. I TRIED THIS ONE NIGHT AND THE NEXT DAY I WOKE UP WITH RED BUMPS, NOT ACNE, ALL OVER THE LEFT SIDE OF MY FACE

I love PTR! I have the cucumber mask that I keep in the fridge and I love it for when I need something to calm my skin or for a cool and fun pick me up. I see everyone always raving about the "Irish moor purifying mud mask" but that one did nothing for my skin. This one is amazing!! I'm not sure how it works for those who suffer with hormonal acne, namely cystic, but I do know it works great for texture. I sometimes get closed comedones and I use this mask twice a week, but I always notice results the next day. It also makes my skin brighter and look healthier with a glow. My skin is already accustomed to acids and strong treatments, so this mask never tingled or burned at all and I'm able to leave it on for the full 7 minutes. I also love the exfoliating properties this mask has. It smells like pumpkin pie too. I will definitely keep repurchasing this because it really does give results!

avis.titre: Mask for all types of acne
avis.texte: This mask is one of PTR best. It burns a little. Not for sensitive skin or people that can't handle a little pain. It worked very well for me. Acne I had on my jaw line and chin were "burned" away. I use it as a spot treatment once and a while too
I bought the set of small sizes of masks in this line and liked the pumpkin the best so bought the full size in it. It smells great, goes on easily and leaves skin very smooth and hydrated.
This is a great mask. It smells amazing and my skin feels and looks so much better.

I am absolutely obsessed with this product. A few years ago I got the 6-piece trial kit with all the masks and this one was love at first use. I am a nurse in the OR, so "maskne" has been a very real problem for me for years, but this mask in combination with the Irish moor mud mask keeps it at bay. I have bought this full size product three times now and it is well worth the price!! I cannot say enough good things about this mask, I use it twice a week and it makes my skin visibly smoother and brighter. Well done PTR!

I've used this mask on and off for a few years (only because it's expensive to repurchase every time I need a new one), but I loveeee it! My acne vanishes within a week of using it, and my skin always looks healthier and more vibrant. Disclaimer: I wouldn't recommend it for super sensitive skin types. Instructions say to leave it on for about 10 minutes, and it literally makes your face SIZZLE the whole time

I tried this product about 6 months ago and I fell in love. Along with the mud mask and hydrating gel. I have sentive skin so have to be careful what I use(Irish & German decent). So I was on the fence but I dove in and I don't regret it. customer for life ❤

I have no idea what the AHA percentage is in here (and nor will PTR ever disclose to me) but the enzymatic effect from the Pumpkin really smooths out the texture of my skin and gives it a 'renewed' appearance. AHA alone doesn't have quite the same effect on me. I massage this gently into my skin for about 30 seconds and then allow it to sit for about 5 minutes. Whenever I mask, I use a scrub first, otherwise what's the point if there's a layer of dead skin in the way? With this one it already contains aluminium oxide crystals so whilst massaging it in, the dead skin cells are removed and the mask works a lot better, plus saving me the extra step. Yes it is a powerful mask and I cannot leave it on for longer than 5 minutes or else my face starts to itch unbearably. Smells like pumpkin and cinnamon - good enough to eat and contains a number of good ingredients - such as Vit A (Retinol) and Vit C. A bit spendy yes, but worth it and infinitely better results using this compared to PTR's 'Cucumber gel masque'. -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herbal Facial Treatment Serum < 6. Eyeliner: Ulta Beauty Gel Eyeliner Pencil < 7. Moisturizer: 'Lush' – Enzymion

I didn't notice a drastic change in my skin afterwards but I did notice A change. Let's be honest, that's better than most products on the market that claim change but don't preform. There was a burning sensation, it didn't last long though, and I have sensitive skin. I will continue to use it, I can't judge it to harshly after only using it 2-3 times. I do like it though and would recommend people to try it, thankfully they sell a sampler set for less money so you can spend $20 to see what you like from their line before you buy bigger. That's what I did :)

It smells nice. It did sting my face a little. But it didn't seem to leave my skin irritated. My face was it's average redness and didn't get more red after use. But it left my face feeling really nice and refreshed, and not like it was irritated. Honestly it says right on the package that it contains an acid, so ppl with sensitive skin will feel a burn/sting. But for me, it didn't actually irritate my skin in the long haul. I just felt slight stinging. But I'm pretty happy with it. Definitely only using once in a while tho. I don't wanna overdo it.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again.  Well worth the price.
avis.texte: I used this product exactly as directed. I used it on Monday, today is Friday and I am still experiencing the glowing results.
Love,love, love it, smells good enough to eat, but don't ! Easy to use and does a great job!
It worked really well on my skin. It didn't burn which I was shocked after hearing the reviews. It deep cleaned my skin without drying it out and gave me a nice glow!

the smell alone would be 5+ stars! I have only used a couple of times, so really can't say how it works quite yet. However, it does leaves my skin feeling smooth after use and feels good when applying it.

42 yr old w hormonal breakouts here and there and lovely discoloration after the breakouts. I am so happy I received this free with my order.Idk if I would ever spend this much on a mask alone😕The smell is ridiculous. I want to eat it. I've used it twice so far and will update if I convince myself it's worth the splurge. No complaints other than price.
Apply mask and gently massage into skin using wet fingers, leave on for ten minutes and rinse. This is a resurfacing mask so it really makes your skin look great!

I use this weekly for a few years. It is wonderful for mature skin. BUT everyone in our home loves it. We use other masks because of our daughter is a make up artist and tries others. This is our favorite

avis.titre: Old formula was fantastic. New one stinks...literally.
avis.texte: Has anyone else noticed the new formula? I bought my third replacement from Ulta last month and finally panned my old one. But when I cracked open the new one, I noticed the color and smell are just ... off. I figured it was a new formula (removing microbeads, maybe?) and gave it a shot. But it doesn't even feel the same. It feels slimy-er and less abrasive. The label is also only in English (rather than English and French) and instead of saying "made in the E.U." it says "made in the USA". I'm so bummed. This was my one skincare "splurge" and it's gone.

avis.titre: I've been using this for years
avis.texte: Wash face apply a small amount to face and neck. Be very careful around your eyes leave on for the amount of time instructions advice to use! Rinse off!

avis.titre: I'm seeing results and I have very senstive skin
avis.texte: I use this product no more than once a week. I leave it on for about 7 minutes, wash off and follow up with the 24K mask. I absolutely LOVE the way this mask smells and I have already seen very noticeable, positive results after using for 3 months.

I've been using this once a week for about a year now and I have noticed a huge change in my skin. I feel like my skin has a glowing look even without foundation. It has also has helped with the appearance of my foundation because of how smooth my skin is now.
The minute you put it on and Burns your face leaving little red dots from chemical burns.

This is a product that I will never not have in my skincare collection! The results are absolutely worth the price. I use the ptr rose stem cell repair mask or cucumber detox moisture mask after and my sking feels brand new.

avis.titre: Love this product buying again for sure!!!
avis.texte: I have struggled with very dry and bumpy skin. The first time I used this make It mad my skin GLOWING!!! Everyone at my school asks what I use. I tell them about this product. If you have super sensitive skin this might not be for you. No Cons. LOVE IT!!! I am a YouTuber, If PTR reads this, I would love to sponsor your products. I have 100,000 subs! goodbye love y'all!

I use a different PTR mask every day of the week and I LOVE this mask! I have sensitive skin and this mask doesn't irritate or leave my skin read. It gives me such a nice, soft glow every time I use this. I'm beyond obsessed with it!

This mask was just okay. You can definitely feel the enzymes working - I'd only had the mask on for a minute or two before I felt an intense tingle. I only left it on for about 3 minutes, on the lowest end of the recommendation, and my skin was still pretty red when I washed it off. I could tell that they enzymes had helped in resurfacing but it was almost a bit too much. I've had better lucky with daily multi-acid peels.
Wash face. Put this on. Smells good. Brush teeth. Do hair, etc. Rinse off. Smooth, soft skin. Don't even need makeup.

This is a great exfoliant for home. It works well and smells fantastic. Not for sensitive skin. I love that the granulated pieces do not break down quickly. Skin was very bright and soft after first use.

This is the best mask I've ever used and during quarantine this will keep you bright! The small amount of time suggested is perfect for sensitive skin. It burned for the first 10 seconds but flew by (thanks wine) and after 4 minutes left my skin glowing like no other mask before! Highly recommend if you have sensitive skin and need that winter layer to come right off.

I LOVE this face mask. It smells heavenly if you're into pumpkin spice scented things and leaves skin clean, soft, and exfoliated. I use this once a week to help with the oil build up I get on my nose and forehead area and it leaves me feeling fresh and ready to start the week!
This product felt wonderful and is definitely affective, however I have rosacea and it was too harsh for my sensitive skin.

I'm addicted to this mask. I love everything about it. Read the directions everyone. I've noticed the only bad reviews clearly used the product incorrectly. You are being trusted to use a salon quality product. I'm in love.

Everyone raves about this mask for good reason. It is gritty without being too harsh – and exfoliating while also being pleasant. Pumpkin scent is yummy, but more yummy to me is feeling my completely smooth skin after I wash it off. The standalone price is steep, so I like to grab it in PTR sets instead.
I've tried a lot of masks and this one is by far the best. It smells amazing and makes my skin glow and feel so clean. Don't hesitate...buy it!

I have limited experience with these products and never know which to buy. This one actually feels good going on and looks good when off. It has a scrubbing and exfoliating effect that works well for clogged pores and dead skin. The enzyme can sting a bit but when washed off, my skin looks healthier and shinier. I have only tried one other PTR mask (Cloud Mask) that did nothing at all. I don't know how this one compares to the others, but it worked well for my sensitive and acne-prone skin. It's not a life changer but it's not a waste of money either. I'd recommend it if it's on sale.

I was super skeptical about trying this but I couldn't afford to keep going to the esthetician to get facials every month. My esti used a pumpkin enzyme peel on me so I figured I'd give this one a try since there was no fragrance and the ingredients were good. Let me tell you I'm so happy I gave this a shot! I get the same results from the esthetician! I have very stubborn hormonal acne and nothing works. At all. Using this product I no longer get whiteheads and my acne and large pores have resided a significant amount! Yes it's going to burn when you put it on it's a AHA I have very sensitive skin and now it's glowing more than ever! PTR please never change the formula!! This stuff works! I'm not getting paid to write this I hope it changes your life as much as it did mine!
I use this product about once a week and it has done amazing things to my skin!!!

avis.titre: It smells like pumpkin spice. The best face mask ever.
avis.texte: I use this product once a week and I love everything about it. it cleans my blocked pores and lifts all of my dead skin away. Worth every dollar.

avis.titre: WORKS BUT THE SMELL IS AWFUL
avis.texte: I do beleive this product works but it smells horrible. I was expecting a lighter pumpkin smell but it literally has an overwhelming pumpkin scent. It smells TOO strong. It literally makes me nauseous. I am weighing out the options of keeping it or returning it. They need to make the smell and little more subtle and not as strong and this product would be perfect.

If I could give this mask no stars I would. Bought this after it was recommended to me by an employee because I complained my skin was oily. Not only did it remove the oils but it completely stripped my skin of all it's important oils. It burns and irritates your skin. Turns it extremely red and causes these little rash patches that look like sun blisters. It smells amazing, like fresh pumpkin, but unless you're looking to burn your face off I suggest other scrubs/masks.

This mask worked great and didn't irritate my dry sensitive skin (I can't use burts bees sensitive skin products, that's how bad my skin is). There is a slight burning sensation when you first apply the mask but it's gone within the first minute. Totally opposite from most masks. Made my skin look and feel fantastic afterward. My esthetician uses pumpkin enzyme masks on me so I feel like I'm getting a really great quality treatment at a much lower price and less time.

avis.titre: The only face mask that matters!!
avis.texte: I have dry skin that can get flaky in areas especially in the winter. Nothing works for exfoliating and smoothing my skin like this mask does! This is a miracle product for me. It can sting a little so it may not be the best for very sensitive skin, but a little burn seems to be normal for this product. I will continue to repurchase FOREVER

I friend recommended this to me a couple years ago and I am so grateful she did!!! This is absolutely awesome at resurfacing the skin without stripping it totally dry. ANNNND IT'S SO SOFT AND IT TONED DOWN MY SKIN IRRITATIONS...go figure...I've tried prescription skin creams and THIS for me at least, has helped my irritated skin. Once weekly, for 5 minutes max for me and I'm good 🙏🏽🥰🙏🏽 It can have a burning feeling if you use too much or leave it on too long. It depends on your skin sensitivity, I don't recommend this for sensitive skin. I'm 49yo and it's helping my skin look 10 years younger...so far.🥰🥰🥰 AWESOME PRODUCT, I will not live without this in my skincare regimen. Grateful 🙏🏽🥰🙏🏽

Hands down. This stuff works. I got this as part of a package of testers from the brand and I was skeptical...especially about the peeling part (obviously didn't realize it didn't mean my face would literally peel). It kind of burns when you first put it on but then you massage it and it goes away. I left it on for about 5 min and washed it off and my skin has NEVER felt so soft. I feel like my forehead can tend to have that rough texture and this just took it away. So excited over this product.

I use this 2-3 times a week. It stings upon first putting it on for me, within 10 seconds the feeling is gone for me. I love the scent, there's so much mask for the price. It's great, leaves my skin glowing and so soft! This is my favorite mask I have ever owned!
Great exfoliation, you can feel the tingle of the acids working, and your skin absolutely glows after use. I adore this product, and I am a discriminating beauty product connoisseur.

I love trying different masks, mostly high end and this is one of the best exfoliating masks I have tried. It is easy to apply (not goopy or dripping everywhere), smells amazing (pumpkin pie) and it really feels like it's doing something to my face (slight burning sensation). I leave it on a little longer than the instructions recommend (10-15 min) and I am left with super smooth skin. Also- I think that over time, using this once or twice a week, my overall complexion has improved (brighter, more even toned). Highly Recommend this mask!
I love this mask!! Smells great and makes my skin so smooth. Took about a month to start seeing a difference in my skin texture. Warning it does feel like it's burning.

Heard great things about this mask, but I'm very disappointed after using it today. It's very rare that a skin care product causes my skin to burn and turn red, but this mask did just that. Very painful sensation almost immediately after putting on the mask, had to take it off early it was so bad. I'm giving this mask 2 stars because it smells amazing, and I did notice my skin was slightly smoother afterwards (besides the redness and irritation).

avis.titre: burns!! wanted to claw my face off
avis.texte: I got this as part of a set during the holidays. It BURNS!! The other masks were fine, but this one hurt and my skin broke out.

I personally did not have any burning feeling I believe that is a mistake for the very fine but rough exfoliation the mask provides. The smell is great and my skins feels completely resurfaced and soft afterward. I recommend to everyone of all ages

Boy does this mask burn but it's so worth it because my skin has never looked better the next morning! I have blemishes (wouldn't call it acne) but it's still enough for me to want to wear foundation. The morning after this mask I didn't even need foundation because my skin looked great. I recommend putting it on the immediately sitting in front of a fan to help soothe the burn. Definitely would recommend it. Maybe try the smaller size that available in the multi pack! All of those masks are amazing as well.
Five because I love the way it feels when I massage it into my skin and it works!

So I waited some months after I got this because skin care is never an instant fix. When I first started using it I used it twice a week for 7 minutes. I in no way have sensitive skin at all. The tingling sensation is tolerable but I noticed a change in my skin not being able to tolerate other skin care products after I used this mask. I also started getting a really bad itching sensation around my nose area when I had it on so I cut my use of it down to once a week for 5 minutes. This seems to work much better for my skin. I don't recommend this if you have sensitive skin at all. Although I do like this product, I feel I have other more affordable masks that make my skin feel just as soft and bright as this one does without the tingling. One thing this mask has done though that no other one has is make my pores seem smaller. Ever since I started using this my pores seem to have gotten smaller especially under my eyes and around my nose which was my biggest reason for buying this mask. I will most likely continue to buy this mask but will keep my use to the minimum.

avis.titre: its not a long term product
avis.texte: my skin is acne prone but by no means sensetive. un the beginning when i first bought this mask it was great and it really polished and improved my skin. however within one month of use, i got chemical burns from using it. the tingling and burning sensation is tolerable if you use wet fingers to massage it. on and all, it does what it is supposed to, but the recommended use is once a week. id go even further and say use it once ever 2 weeks or once a month
Literally saw results instantly! It is not for sensitive skin. It burns a little bit but polished your skin so beautifully. I love the smell of pumpkin and fall! I use this once a week!

I love this mask! Makes a huge difference in brightness and texture of my skin. I have sensitive skin so I only leave it on for about 3-5 minutes, then I follow it up with the PTR cucumber gel mask, perfect combo twice a week.

I had high hopes for this because it smells delicious, but it burned like crazy the moment I put it on! I made the mistake of continuing to do a quick layer over my entire face. I probably made it about 20 seconds before I couldn't handle the burning anymore, and my face was already turning red and splotchy. I've never had sensitive skin or any kind of reaction to any beauty/cosmetics products before this.

this mask is lovely! it does exactly what it says, plus it smells heavenly. It brings up dirt and oil trapped in your pores so don't be shocked if you see pimples pop up, that's what is supposed to happen. It also exfoliates very nicely. This is one of the only things that helps me clear stubborn acne. I love peter thomas roth masks, they all do exactly what they claim to do and they do it amazingly!!

This is way overpriced for the product you get. I don't understand how everyone else is getting results, because the only thing this does for me is irritate my skin. I used it twice a week for a month and there were absolutely no differences between before and after. If anything, my skin became more sensitive. Wouldn't recommend. The Andalou Naturals pumpkin honey glycolic mask is way cheaper and does a way better job.
I love this product-I have repurchased it many times- it works well and leaves my face feeling and looking great

I'm a student & hate hate hate spending money on non-essentials. I've purchased this mask twice and have not regretted it! It makes my skin glow like I just got a facial, and I notice it clears up my acne as well. Plus it smells great!

I'm a minimum wage gal at the moment and I'm very picky with what I spend my money on, this is completely worth it to me and is something I will for sure repurchase. I have very dry skin with an oily tzone and my skin is quick to dry out or become inflamed when I put something bad on my face. This so does exactly what it says it's gonna do, every time I use it I feel like a shiny new penny and it just never disappoints and never bothers my skin. I rinse it off and immediately have smoother skin than I did before, and it looks refreshed and brightened in a way that makes it look like I went to a spa! Strong enough to get the job done well, gentle enough to use consistently without a problem. A holy grail
This product made me break out and it ripped up my pores because it was so rough on the skin!

I purchased this in a set with samples of all the other mask and they all were great. When I went to try this one, it burnt so bad that I had to rinse my face in a cold water bath.Im sure it's a good mask for SOME but not all. I would recommend sampling a small bit before slapping all over your face. Not sure what would have cause it to burn.

This mask has changed my skin. My pores are appearing to be tighter. My skin is overall more even and actually brighter. It does not dry my skin out or irritate it and even helps to keep breakouts at bay triggered by stress that I have had issues with for over a year now. I will never let myself run out of this mask. It is amazing and MORE than worth the price.

avis.titre: The best thing for large pores
avis.texte: I use this 2-3 times a week. I love that it is gentle enough to use as a face scrub and a mask. Make sure you leave it on for 5-7 min for the best results. Smells just like a pumpkin pie. I just can't say enough good things about this product. It has helped my pores appear so much smaller. Worth the splurge , trust me. Only complaint I have is that my face does feel a little dry after I wash it off but honestly it is to be expected and it's nothing a little moisturizer can't fix. Will definitely be purchasing another when mine runs out

I got this in a sample pack of other PTR masks, and this was the first I tried. I have combination-ish skin, with dry patches on my nose and forehead and seborrheic dermatitis on my cheeks, giving it a red, almost rosacea-like quality. I was initially nervous that it would inflame my redness. When I put it on, it smelled amazing, right off the bat. Not a cloying sweetness, but like a legit pumpkin pie. There was a slight warm tingle at first, but it went away fairly quickly. I left it on for around 7 minutes. It was an amaaaazing exfoliator, I no longer have the dry, flakiness on my nose (which seemed like it would never go away), my skin is smooth and soft. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all, and that's a miracle in and of itself! I will be purchasing this in the larger size whenever I've finished my sample-- a little does go a long way!
Use it. Couple of times a week. Gentle but effective & smells wonderful.

avis.titre: This will make your skin feel fabulous!
avis.texte: This has to be at the top of any masks I've used in the past. My skin felt so clean and "alive". I have combination skin, however I live in South FL so it really tends to be more oily due to excessive humidity here. If your skin is like mine, I really think you will love this!

Love this mask! I deal with acne and hormonal break outs! As well as hyperpigmentation! This keeps my skin clean , heals acne I had from past, and is making my skin glowy and am even skin tone! Love it so much and buy it over and over again!
Excellent this product is strong use lightly at first until you get used to its.poentcy..this product does it's job ..xo

So I got this when I got the mini mask try it kit and this is my absolute favorite one!! I have super oily skin and constant blackhead and usually always have 2 or 3 full blown pimples as any given time. I used this mask twice in one week and I dare say my skin was clear!!?? I was AMAZED at how well it works. Also your face will be as soft as a baby butt after using this no joke. Currently the full size is sold out but I keep checking because there is no way I can ever live my life without this ever again. TOTAL game changer!!!

This is a wonderful exfoliating mask on every level. It's gentle but provides noticeable results, you don't need to use a lot of product, and it smells wonderful. My one wish is that a smaller size was available; a jar lasts forever.

I wouldn't really call this a mask. It is more like a peel. In fact it felt like a mild glycolic chemical peel. It definitely stung a bit, but I can get past that. This product leaves my skin feeling so refined. I have used this twice now and my skin is glowing. I have minor breakouts from stress and hormones with a few blackheads on my nose and chin. This has improved both my breakouts and blackheads. My pores look smaller too. I have very dry skin and this has definitely exfoliated off most of my dry patches. I will be repurchasing this for sure.

Okay so yeah sure there's aluminum beads to help exfoliate and that's worrying to some. With that said, if it doesn't bother you, this mask will NOT disappoint you. I'm an esthetician so I've used professional enzyme masks that have better results, but out of all the ones I've tried that are available to the "public" and not licensed professionals, this one is the best. It works great on my oily skin as I have pores that get easily clogged. You can really FEEL it working. Just be sure to put rub this onto your skin very very gently as the aluminum beads (though teeny tiny) can be abrasive if you're too rough.

I have struggled with my skin for years!! I use the Clinique three step system, but the system failed to really get those unclogged pores and no exfoliater seemed to do the trick. this mask is pricey but it does really work! My skin has NEVER looked better and the texture is beyond smooth and soft- super impressed! The price is high but totally worth it !

avis.titre: The best mask I've ever used
avis.texte: The only mask I've ever used that provides immediate results! Every time I put this on my face (2-3 times a week since I've bought it) it makes my skin so smooth. Completely repairs my skin texture and adds a brightness and smoothness that I'm really not sure even Facetune could provide. It smells like pumpkin pie and you only have to leave it on for 3-7 minutes so its very convenient for busy mornings or sleepy nights. I have stubborn post acne scars on my face and with the help of this mask, a majority of them are nearly faded or GONE! Its 1,000% worth the investment!

I bought this mask because the combination of my hormonal acne and the humidity was doing a number on my face. I had a couple deep pimples and the surrounding areas were either oily or flaky and dry. This is not normal for my skin so I researched some masks and came across this one. I don't know if it was anticipation of fall or the fact that literally everyone recommended this mask, but I ran to the nearest Ulta to buy it. No regrets. Within days my skin returned to its normal, clear state.
Smells great, I've only had this product a week, but so far i love it. I have noticed it has reduced redness in pimples.

I bought this as a spur of the moment along with the PTR Retinol. Just love the smell and use it twice a week as a scrub and once a week as a mask. My skin feels amazing afterwards. I gave it to my son to try as he loves masks and he went right out and got some. My face feels so clean. I put it on my neck and it all feels tighter, brighter and best of all, there is SO much product - very good value for the price! Definitely would purchase this again. Really like the PTR line.

avis.titre: great for my acne !! smells amazing !!
avis.texte: I am a 23 year old female with constant acne. nothing terrible but I always have multiple pimples black heads and pimples in the process of healing. I have used this mask maybe 4 times over the past two weeks and have seen a significant difference in my acne. I saw a difference after the first use. I love love love the smell (it's smells like pumpkin pie.) I have normal combo oily skin and it has not made the oil any worse has not over died or anything like that just left me with smooth clearer skin with each use. I love that it's a mask and an exfoliant I got mine in the maskaholic kit and will be purchasing more when I run out as long as it continues working. definitely recommend giving it a try !!

This mask is one of two holy grail PTR products. This and the Irish Moor Mud used 2x a week (alternating) have completely changed my skin. No more breakouts, uneven tone, and my texture is gone. It's pricey, but I no longer need monthly facials so I save that expense. These are some of the very few products I repurchase again and again.

I got this as a gift for Mother's Day because I have a health issue that cause dry patches on my face. I have tried many things and nothing ever totally gets rid of the dry skin, but this did! My skin feels better and looks better. Love it.
This is a great mask but the second time I ordered it online I received a previously opened product.
It burned my skin seconds after application. I don't have sensitive skin, but it burned so badly, it wasn't on my face longer than a minute. It left red spots all over my face! Definitely not for me!

okay so like i have horrible skin. it's either too oily or too dry. no in between. i always have uncontrollable breakouts. i've tried every mask, cleanser, toner, ect. and nothing was getting rid of my acne. recently, i've has horrible dry skin patches under my eyes and around my lips. it burned no matter what i did. nothing was helping. so i used this mask and i must say, it's a miracle. this mask exfoliates so it took away al the dead/dry skin i was having issues with AND made my face brighter. i've also had issues with cakey makeup. no matter how little foundation i used. or how much primer i used. but i put my foundation on like normal after this mask, and my face is so smooth and no longer cakey! it's amazing. i'm hoping i continue to use this and i see results on my acne.

I bought the mask-o-holic set for myself as a Christmas present. I love the irish moor mud and the pumpkin enzyme is my favourite! The sizes in the set are all 1.7oz which is smaller than the individual at 5oz but i still have alot left. The pumpkin enzyme is down to half a jar (and i use it at least once/twice a week). I bought the full size because i had ulta points and dread when i do run-out of it. Im 46 yrs young and use lots of anti-aging skincare and masks. The aztec clay (very good but can be very drying), bubble mask (okay) and many others. Peter Thomas Roths are the best! They are pricey but last so i say definitely worth it!

i held out on buying this for the longest time because of the price, but i bought it in a bundle at Christmas and it is incredible. it's worth every penny and a little goes a long way. my skin is glowing because of this. definitely will repurchase!!

I do have to say that a little goes a long way! This is probably one of the most amazing masks I've ever used!!! I was worried it was going to burn my face because of Health chemical peels before. I was very surprised that it didn't burn at all!! This made my face extremely soft, filled in Fine lines, helped with dark spots, and I saw a glow in my skin!! A little goes a long way too!

This is by far my favorite Peter Thomas Roth mask! But buyer beware if you have ultra sensitive skin I would probably skip it because it burns a for the first ~3 minutes it's on the skin. Another tip is to avoid using it the night before you have to look your best. I find the day after my skin looks dull. Two days later it looks much better than before.

This mask is amazing. It truly is a facial in a jar. My face looks brand new every time I use this product. It smells delicious which is always a plus. It does tingle/burn for a couple seconds after application but that's just the enzymes doing their job so nothing to be alarmed about. I got this in the Mask-a-holic set, but will definitely be buying a full size jar when I run out.

This mask is amazing. It truly is a facial in a jar. My face looks brand new every time I use this product. It smells delicious which is always a plus. It does tingle/burn for a couple seconds after application but that's just the enzymes doing their job so nothing to be alarmed about. I got this in the Mask-a-holic set, but will definitely be buying a full size jar when I run out.
This was included in the maskaholic set I bought and I can't even begin to describe the amazing results you get from this mask. Do yourself a favor and buy this!
Good lord, this mask feels like it is burning your face off! But after a few minutes of pain my face feels soooo smooth and its so shiny. I love it

I bought the PTR mask sampler set. None of the other masks worked for me EXCEPT this one. It definitely smells like fresh pumpkin. I got a little scared after I applied it because my face was somewhat irritated, kinda felt like it was burning a little. But I googled the effects, and thats what usually happens as an effect of the pumpkin enzymes eating away at your dead skin cells. The burning sensation quickly went away. When I washed the mask off, my skin felt smoother, and appeared to be brighter. I will buy full size jar.

I love this mask. Ran out of Josie Maran's Mud Mask and while browsing in ULTA, came across this. Tried a small tester size on the back of my hand and wow, what a difference! My skin is smooth and soft and toned. I use approximately 3 times a week and trade off with the PTR Irish Moor Mud Mask.

avis.titre: I did buy this product again after using it for a year.
avis.texte: I have used this product over a year now and just love it. I do use it at least every other day. My aging skin seems to like it. :) It smells good and makes my skin feel soft.

avis.titre: LOVE this and so do many others in Harrisburg!
avis.texte: I use every other evening. Skin is brighter, more even, and acne has improved. My first jar is getting low and I went today to both locations in Harrisburg PA, and both are sold out! Ulta, your Harrisburg people need more!

as a licensed esthetician this product is absolutely amazing. if you're sensitive I'd build up to the 7 minute maximum it recommends. overall it's great to get the fresh, radiant skin. overall love all PTR products

This scrub mask smells amazing and I feel like it really works on removing dead skin cells from the face. Having said that, it was slightly irritating on my combination skin. I am not typically sensitive to facial products, so if you are, I would definitely recommend trying this out in store before buying it.
I've heard about this stuff for years and finally broke down and tried it. I could feel it tingling and mg skin looked fresh and felt soft and clean. I'll be buying this again. Very Impressive.

I bought this product after a referral from a friend, the brand also attracted me because I had used PTR body wash and lotion before and loved it. This product is gentle enough that it doesn't irritate the skin, but it still scrubs away dead skin and leaves my face feeling refreshed and bright. The fact that it doubles as a face mask is a plus as well. Double the power that scrubbing alone doesn't always do.

I've had two facials with a pumpkin peel and they are amazing! I purchased this to replace getting facials with hopefully the same results and so far so good! It is a strong intense mask and by that, I mean you can feel it working! You build up to 7 minutes and I would reccomend people following those guidelines. I will purchase again!
This is a great mask to use multiple times per week. It makes my pores look tighter and my skin feels more smooth. I like the tingling sensation and exfoliation from the crystals.
Exfoliated my face left the mascon to maestros so that my skin looks amazing.

This is amazing to use once a week. Its a 3 in one mask. I love how my skin in glowing and soft afterwards. It makes me skin less oily. Make sure to wear spf the next few days after use though, AHAs cause sensitivity and makes you burn easy in the sun.

I first tried the pumpkin enzyme mask in the PTR Maskaholic set. After using it regularly (once every 3-4 days) for a few weeks, I can definitely see an overall improvement in my skin tone and clarity. As someone who deals with PCOS, I struggle with breakouts along my chin and jawline. This mask has absolutely helped clear those up, to where now if I do get a pimple, it's only one, it's very small, and it's gone within a few days. After seeing the amount I had left in my smaller size container drop dramatically, I went ahead and bought the full size. This is absolutely a skincare staple for me at this point.
My esthetician recommended this and she hasn't steered me wrong yet.

I purchased this product after reading about it on line. I have used it once a could tell a difference. I read other comments stating the product burned however I could feel it tickling but not burning.
This product is amazing. Some might feel a burning sensation, but it's normal especially if you have sensitive skin.

This product really resurfaces your skin. I don't have sensitive skin but when I put this on my cheeks they started burning. It lasted for about 2 minutes and then went away. And it smellls great, like pumpkin spice! My skin felt very smooth afterwards. But, my skin did not look too good. I have some dark spots and small acne scars, but it didn't do anything for that. But my face did feel very smooth and clean. Use with caution!

I was in need of a new mask for my face and I came across this and I had to give it a chance. And I'm in love with this mask! My face has not felt this amazing in so long!! Since you don't need a lot for your face you can make this last for a long time. Also it smells like pumpkin pie which I cannot get enough of!

avis.titre: Why I went to Ulta... to buy this
avis.texte: I went to Ulta to buy this am love it. It is an enzyme mask so it does tingle a bit. I have sensitive skin and was able to tolerate it for 7 minutes. My skin feels very smooth from using this (and other products by PTR).

This mask is amazing!! This was the first product from the Peter Thomas Roth line that I have purchased and I am so glad I did!! When I first applied the mask it did have a tingling/slightly burning sensation, but I felt it was bearable. After about two minutes, the sensation was gone and it just left my face feeling refreshed. It is a very light mask and it is extremely easy to remove. This will definitely become a staple product for me!
I received this as a sample, didn't plan on completely falling in love with the product. My skin is very dry, but this mask exfoliates and leaves my skin feeling amazing! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: This mask will ALWAYS be a staple
avis.texte: This mask is worth the price and it does last a long time. This mask will always be a staple of mine. It has tiny little pumpkins seeds or something that really help with exfoliating away dead skin. It says leave the mask on for 3-7 minutes but of course I do what I want over here so I leave it on an hour or however long I feel like it. When I wash the mask off my skin looks sooo much healthier and it's noticeably brighter and looks more even. I don't use this mask every day but I do think it would be great for everyday use. I can feel the mask actually penetrating into my pores and if I have a small break out it dramatically reduces after using this mask. I will always repurchase this mask because it works in more ways than one.

avis.titre: Professional Facial Grade with significant outcome
avis.texte: I am a 50-year-old female with historical sun damage, ACNE scars and fine lines. I also have combination skin. I found this mask very effective to even out my skin tone - minimize sun damage and old ACNE scars and pretty much smooth my skin (no more fine lines) only after about 2 months of use. I have to mention though, this product is very "professional grade" with potent ingredients. I can feel my face tingle (meaning that the enzyme is doing its work). So please allergy check before you use it on your entire face. Reserve sufficient time when you incorporate this product in your skincare regimen. You need to put this product on your face and wait a few minutes the enzyme could do its work and then gently massage your face for a couple of minutes to let the exfoliator remove dead skin cells. This is in general a very effective product.

I was first drawn to this item because of the smell. Pumpkin pie! The is also great for exfoliating skin. I used it to remove an uneven self tan. It worked great. I use this about once a week. My detailed review is below.

Im 21 and have acne scares from years of cystic acne, after one time using this and doing then thinnest layer most of my acne scars are gone!!! I couldn't believe it!! Even my family members couldn't believe my skin, it convinced my mom so much she ordered it and her skin has never looked better!! Her wrinkles have diminished immensely and skin tone is even!! Buy this you will not be disappointed!!!

avis.titre: Not for the sensitive and dried out skin....
avis.texte: I am trying out PRT for the first time. This is my second mask that I have used from the mask-a-holic gift box. I made sure to clean my skin very gently due to not using it during my routine. I have no problems with the smell, enjoyed the initial placement onto my face. But soon after my face specifically where I have problems with dryness and irritations flared up. It was painful during the portion I was rubbing the product in and when waiting for the time duration. It seemed to have subsided a bit over time but the initial pain was awful. I could see the redness through the mask. After I rinsed off the mask I didn't see any difference. Except, more redness and dryness. Would recommend for someone else's skin but not mine...way too harsh and didn't do anything.

I got a sample of this product and I absolutely love it! It is the best exfoliator that I have ever used. I wouldn't recommend it for really sensitive skin, it is pretty harsh. But if you don't have sensitive skin this is definitely worth the price. It really helps with the texture on my skin. I will be buying the full size!

This mask is awesome, I saw results literally overnight. It made my face smoother and I have acne scars and they were barely noticeable when I woke up. It's worth the money.. a little goes a long way with this stuff and you get a big jar of it! Also it smells like pumpkin pie!

This is the first mask I've tried from this brand, and first of all it smells incredible! It's exactly like pumpkin pie. If you're sensitive to smells, this might be a bit much. So far I love it, it exfoliates gently, leaving my skin soft and visibly brightens. I wouldn't use it every day, but 2-3 times per week has been great so far!
I use it once a week and love how my skin feels after using it. And the smell is wonderful.

avis.titre: Love it love it love it
avis.texte: Oh my goodness wow! First time I did this mask, I only noticed my skin texture improved... But after a couple of weeks, my blackheads have cleared and my hyper pigmentation is slowly but surely fading! Highly reccomend for spot treating oily sections of your face. Only reason I gave it four stars is because it can dry you out, and definitely takes a few uses to see the crazy results people rave about with ptr products.

I'm 26 and I have extremely dull skin with an occasional break out here or there. I have combination skin and while feeling it looked great after a facial, I only get one once a month and my skin turns dull again. I use great products and believe my skin overall looks better because of them but it was still lacking so I tried this to give it a boost. I've used this twice a week for the past 3 weeks and my skin feels and looks amazing. It's really cleared up, looks glowy and smooth. This product allows my other products to do their job.
Love this hurts a little but omg it works so good will always buy this brand so satisfied with this product worth the money and a little goes a long way!

So I am someone who loves masks and is always looking to expand my horizons. My cousin recommended this mask saying it works amazing and smells divine so of course I had to try it. It's a bit pricey, but I figured your skin is worth it. Boy was I wrong! I've tried this mask twice now and both times I've had to wash it off almost immediately. It burned and stung so badly that there was no way I could deal with 7 minutes of it. I am not someone with sensitive skin, and I have used this brand before, so I have no idea what caused it. All I know is I will never out this mask near my face again.
